Mary at Jesus’ Feet

Richard Crashaw (G.) (c. 1613–1649)

‘Mary which also sat at Jesus’ feet, and heard His word.’—L
UKE
 
X.
 39
.
B
EHOLD
 a new thing here—host hanging on her Guest:
Preparing for His mouth, His mouth’s words are her feast!
O Martha sister, spare thy labour and thy cost:
Tending the food that perisheth, diviner food is lost.
